g.text: The grader is a model too: three known habits
picks the first one more often
the same answer wins more often in slot A
even when the content is no better,
a padded answer beats a crisp correct one
match lengths, or control for it
three of the same model will not fix it
None of these wash out by averaging over many runs: they are a lean, not noise
So before trusting a judge, calibrate it against a small human-graded set
